exposure: adherence to anti-diabetic therapy (diet, physical activity and medications)
cohort: 157 pregnant women with diabetes in Harare, Zimbabwe
finding: Sub-optimal adherence to anti-diabetic therapy was associated with several adverse perinatal outcomes, including Caesarean delivery, candidiasis, low Apgar scores, and perinatal mortality.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was significantly associated with adherence to anti-diabetic therapy.
